summary: The Qode Membership plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to...
description: The Qode Membership plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.6.2 via the qode_membership_check_facebook_user AJAX action. This is due to a typographic error in the Facebook OAuth token verification guard within the qode_membership_login_user_from_social_network function — the guard condition tests an undefined variable ($check_social_useqoder instead of $check_social_user), causing empty() to always return true and rendering the Graph API token verification branch dead code, leaving wp_set_auth_cookie() reachable with no credential or token validation whatsoever. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to log in as any existing WordPress account — including Administrator-level accounts — by supplying a known or enumerated administrator login name (rather than an email address) in the response[email] parameter, which the fallback path in get_user_by('login', $email) resolves to the matching account. Exploitation does require harvesting a valid qode_validate_facebook_login nonce, but this nonce is rendered on any public front-end page containing the [qode_user_login] or [qode_user_register] shortcode and is therefore obtainable without any prior authentication.

summary: Psono Server (CE & EE) versions 1.0.0 through 7.2.3 did not enforce the direction of file...
description: Psono Server (CE & EE) versions 1.0.0 through 7.2.3 did not enforce the direction of file-transfer credentials on file-repository operations. summary: Psono Server CE && EE versions 4.0.33 through 7.2.3 compared the request path for the bulk-secret...
description: Psono Server CE && EE versions 4.0.33 through 7.2.3 compared the request path for the bulk-secret-read endpoint with a hard-coded unprefixed path. In deployments configured with URL_PREFIX, the comparison failed and the POST request was authorized using write scope instead of read scope. An authenticated remote attacker with an unusual read-disabled, write-enabled API key could therefore retrieve encrypted secret data and nonces through the prefixed bulk-secret-read endpoint despite lacking read permission. The default configuration without URL_PREFIX was not affected.

summary: Psono Server versions 5.3.5 through 7.2.3 used a permission class that did not enforce token...

An authenticated remote attacker holding a restricted API key-derived session could claim an attacker-controlled device code and obtain a full read-write session valid for up to 365 days, bypassing the original token's scope and lifetime restrictions. This did not bypass two-factor authentication or directly disclose plaintext secrets.

Connections still required TLS certificate validation, and the flaw did not provide arbitrary protocol or port access. Unresponsive targets could also occupy a server worker until the operating-system timeout.

description: In apache-airflow-providers-ssh before 7.0.1, SSHRemoteJobOperator quoted the values of its templated `environment` parameter only once, although they are placed inside an already-quoted wrapper script, so shell syntax such as `$(...)` in a value was executed on the remote SSH host. Users are advised to upgrade apache-airflow-providers-ssh to 7.0.1 or later.

Attackers can supply a crafted GGUF model with a short tokenizer.ggml.tokens array, causing llama-cli or llama-server to read past id_to_token and crash.

summary: DevilutionX 1.4.0 through 1.5.5 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the bundled...
description: DevilutionX 1.4.0 through 1.5.5 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the bundled libmpq libmpq__file_number_from_hash function that allows attackers to read heap memory via unchecked block_table_index values. Attackers can place a crafted .mpq archive in the game's data path, such as a mod, to trigger reads past mpq_map and crash the game.

summary: llama.cpp b5899 before b10261 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in...
description: llama.cpp b5899 before b10261 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in llm_tokenizer_plamo2::build that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted GGUF models. Attackers can supply BYTE-typed token text like <0x-1> whose negative parsed value writes token ids before the bytes_ buffer during model loading, causing crashes or potential code execution.

summary: llama.cpp before b2731 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in llama_model_loader that...
description: llama.cpp before b2731 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in llama_model_loader that allows attackers to read memory outside the mapped model file via crafted GGUF tensor offsets. Attackers can supply a crafted or truncated GGUF model file with arbitrary 64-bit tensor offsets to crash the process or load adjacent process memory as model weights.

summary: A malicious actor with access to the adjacent network could exploit a Heap-based Buffer Overflow...
description: A malicious actor with access to the adjacent network could exploit a Heap-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability found in airMAX M, LTU, SolarPoint, and SolarSwitch devices to execute arbitrary code on the device.

summary: llama.cpp before b3701 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in llama_decode_internal and...
description: llama.cpp before b3701 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in llama_decode_internal and llama_encode_internal that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read memory by supplying unvalidated token IDs. Attackers can send integer-array prompts to the llama-server /completion endpoint with IDs outside 0 to n_vocab to read embedding memory out of bounds or crash the process.

summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the Bazar CSV import...
description: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the Bazar CSV import copyUrlToLocalFile() function that allows authenticated administrators to make arbitrary outbound requests by supplying crafted URLs in CSV file or image fields. Attackers can bypass the extension check with a query-string suffix or redirects to fetch cloud metadata credentials, internal services, or local files via file://, with responses stored in the web-accessible files/ directory.

summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows...
description: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject JavaScript by supplying query parameters matching missing Bazar field names. Attackers can craft links where BazarField::getValue() falls back to unsanitized $_REQUEST values rendered via Twig |raw templates, performing same-origin authenticated actions in victims' sessions.

summary: YesWiki from 4.6.2 before 4.7.0 lacks replay protection in HttpSignatureService::verifySignature(...
description: YesWiki from 4.6.2 before 4.7.0 lacks replay protection in HttpSignatureService::verifySignature(), which never validates the Date header or tracks seen signatures. Attackers who capture a signed request to the /api/forms/{formId}/actor/inbox endpoint can replay it later to re-execute Delete, Update, Follow, or Undo actions.

summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in handlers/page...
description: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in handlers/page/referrers_sites.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via crafted Referer headers. Attackers can send a Referer hostname containing HTML metacharacters that renders unescaped, executing JavaScript for any referrer-sites page visitor to perform same-origin authenticated actions.

summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in DuplicationManager:...
description: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in DuplicationManager::downloadFile() that allows authenticated administrators to make arbitrary outbound requests via the files array. Attackers can POST file:// or internal URLs to /api/pages/{tag}/duplicate, storing local files, cloud metadata, or database credentials in the publicly accessible files/ directory.

summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an unauthenticated ClickHouse sql injection vulnerability that...
description: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an unauthenticated ClickHouse sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL through the projectId parameter of the /live/visitors/:projectId WebSocket, which lacks session and project-access checks. Attackers can use UNION or boolean count oracles to read other tenants' events and profiles, and project members can similarly inject via the cohort.preview timeframe values.

summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in BazarListeAction that allows...
description: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in BazarListeAction that allows unauthenticated attackers to select arbitrary templates within the @bazar Twig namespace via the template GET parameter. Attackers can append crafted template values to pages containing the bazarliste action to force unintended layouts, causing page defacement for visitors following the crafted link.

summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an information exposure vulnerability that writes database...
description: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an information exposure vulnerability that writes database connection URLs and email template data to standard output logs. Users with log access can obtain database credentials from migration startup logs and password-reset tokens logged when SMTP_HOST and RESEND_API_KEY are unset.

cwes.name: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows read-level...
description: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows read-level project members to obtain plaintext integration secrets because the notification.rules query skips redactIntegration. Attackers can call the notification.rules tRPC query to retrieve Slack bot tokens, webhook URLs, and authorization headers for use against external systems.

cwes.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a sql injection vulnerability in despam.php where the from...
description: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a sql injection vulnerability in despam.php where the from parameter is escaped but placed in an unquoted INTERVAL position. Authenticated administrators can inject SQL via the from POST parameter to perform blind reads of the database including user password hashes.

summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the event.bots tRPC...
description: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the event.bots tRPC procedure that allows unauthenticated attackers to read bot events by only checking shareOverview row existence. Attackers can send anonymous requests with a projectId to retrieve bot-event names, types, and paths for private or password-protected projects, revealing internal routes.

summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows...
description: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access the Bull Board dashboard served on the worker HTTP port. Attackers can query /api/queues and call mutating Bull Board APIs to add, retry, or clean jobs and read queue data, metrics, and datastore health.
